top_signals.title: Surprise Slowdown in Turkish Inflation Makes Case for Rate Cut
top_signals.summary: Turkish inflation continued to slow in September, raising the prospect of an interest rate cut at the next central bank meeting to help ease liquidity strains stemming from a domestic funds crisis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Move to hold vote on November 29 comes after government defeat on legislation aimed at ending housing crisis
